paper_metadata.title: A precipitation strengthened high entropy alloy with high (Al + Ti) content for laser powder bed fusion: Synergizing intrinsic hot cracking resistance and ultrahigh strength

evidence.quote: Here, we overcome this trade-off in AM of a multicomponent Ni-rich precipitation-strengthened high-entropy alloy (MNiHEA) Ni46.23Co23Cr10Fe5Al8.5Ti4W2Mo1C0.15B0.1Zr0.02 (at%): synergizing remarkable hot-cracking resistance and ultrahigh strength.

Customized pre-alloyed powder of the designed MNiHEA is used in this study. The powder is fabricated by Xi’an Sailong AM Technology Co., Ltd (Xi’an, China), using the plasma rotating electrode process atomization technique.
The cuboid samples with the dimensions of 55 × 12 × 5 mm3 are fabricated on 316L stainless steel base plates using an AconityMini LPBF machine
Some of the as-built (AB) cuboids are isothermally aged at 800 ◦C for 4 h, which are hereafter referred to as ABG for brevity.
No grain-boundary brittle TCP intermetallic phases in the as-cast followed by aging (ACG) MNiHEA
The powder is fabricated by Xi’an Sailong AM Technology Co., Ltd (Xi’an, China), using the plasma rotating electrode process atomization technique.

The laser power, scanning speed and hatch spacing are 180 W, 600 mm/s and 120 μm, respectively. The powder layer thickness is 30 μm and the unidirectional scan path with interlayer rotation of 67◦ is used
Some of the as-built (AB) cuboids are isothermally aged at 800 ◦C for 4 h, which are hereafter referred to as ABG for brevity.
The pre-alloyed powder and AB MNiHEA are an FCC single-phase structure and the ABG MNiHEA is an FCC - L12 dual-phase structure.

attributes.composition: strongly enriched in Ni, Al, Ti and W and depleted in Co, Cr and Fe

evidence.quote: The average size, volume fraction and inter-precipitate spacing of the IR-NPs are measured to be ~22 nm, ~70% and ~8 nm, respectively
The mean size of the DCs is ~0.5 μm.
The high aspect-ratio coarse columnar grains have a mean width of ~31 ± 13 μm and penetrate through several molten pools along the building direction.
After the aging treatment at 800 ◦C for 4 h, the high-density nanoprecipitates strengthened DC structure indeed forms in the ABG MNiHEA, as we designed.
the pores that exist are identified as irregularly shaped lack-of-fusion (LOF) pores with relatively large sizes and solidification (SOD) pores with fine sizes

attributes.location: molten pool boundaries and inside the molten pools

evidence.quote: Fine solidification pores with sizes of 1~3 μm locate at the molten pool boundaries and inside the molten pools
The AB and ABG MNiHEA exhibit a high yield strength (0.2% offset strength, σ0.2) of 897 ± 39 MPa, and an ultrahigh yield strength as high as 1157 ± 71 MPa, respectively

The ultimate tensile strength (σUTS) of the AB and ABG MNiHEA reach 1117 ± 31 MPa and 1327 ± 58 MPa
The ultimate tensile strength (σUTS) of the AB and ABG MNiHEA reach 1117 ± 31 MPa and 1327 ± 58 MPa
The uniform elongation of the AB MNiHEA is 14.5 ± 2.3%
It decreases down to 6.5 ± 0.2% in the ABG MNiHEA
The most effective strengthening mechanism is solid-solution hardening, by which the lattice friction stress increases up to ~458 MPa.
The precipitate-free AB MNiHEA has a higher yield strength than the SP-ACG and IRP-ACG MNiHEA due to the dislocation-hardening effect, which contributes approximately 314 MPa.
Although the strength contribution of precipitation-hardening (~227 MPa) is not the highest, the high-density IR-NPs are indispensable for achieving this ultrahigh strength.

The least effective strengthening mechanism is grain-boundary strengthening, which is more significant in the AB and ABG MNiHEA than those in the two ACG counterparts because the former two fabricated by the LPBF have the finer microstructures.

evidence.section: 4.3 Deformation and strain-hardening mechanisms for uniform ductility
evidence.quote: The high-density IR-NP particles enhance plastic stability of the DC structure at ultrahigh stress level under tension, providing sufficient strain-hardening and thus uniform ductility
